high_level_description: This image captures a stunning view of the night sky, prominently featuring the Milky Way galaxy. The central part of the image is dominated by the bright, glowing band of the Milky Way, which appears as a dense cluster of stars and cosmic dust. The band is illuminated with a soft white and yellowish hue, indicating the presence of starlight and possibly some nebulae. The surrounding area is filled with countless stars scattered across the dark expanse of space, creating a sense of depth and vastness.
